purpose: Independent local RIFE video frame interpolation; assets remain outside Git
implementation: Veyra DirectML FP16 graph translator, D3D12 warp/composition, external-provider adapter

model.modifications: None; unmodified NCNN export parsed at runtime

algorithmReference.adaptation: Model execution and warping contract consulted; the external CPU reference reuses the unchanged CPU Warp forward function. Product inference is independently implemented using DirectML/D3D12.

directML.license: Package LICENSE.txt and ThirdPartyNotices.txt retained with local runtime

providerInterface: Existing external NGX SDK headers at build time only. Export names preserve Veyra's provider ABI; no NVIDIA inference binary or weights are used by this FG provider.
distribution: Local experimental package only; no public release performed
